cues.title: 记录两个力的共同效果
cues.titleEn: Record the effect of two forces
cues.caption: 记住O点、两条方向和两个读数。
cues.captionEn: Record O, two directions and both readings.
cues.zh: 把橡皮条固定一端，另一端接小圆环。用两只测力计沿不同方向拉，让圆环停在O点。现在要记录三类信息：O点的位置、两条拉力方向和两个读数。仅仅记下两个数字还不够，因为方向也是力的一部分。橡皮条此时的伸长与方向，给接下来的替换提供了共同的效果标准。
cues.en: Fix one end of an elastic strip and attach a ring to the other. Pull in two directions with force meters until the ring rests at O. Record the position, both force directions and both readings. Two numbers alone are insufficient because direction matters. The strip extension and orientation establish the effect the replacement must reproduce.

cues.title: 单力恢复同一O点
cues.caption: 同一位置，使橡皮条对圆环的力相同。
cues.captionEn: The same position restores the same strip force.
cues.zh: 改用一只测力计，沿合适方向把圆环拉回刚才的O点。固定端没动，O点也没动，橡皮条的伸长和方向就恢复原样。因此这个单独的力，与原来的两个力产生相同效果。注意这里比较的是同一个位置，不能只凭看起来差不多，也不能先把两个读数直接相加再当成答案。
cues.en: Replace the pair with a single meter and bring the ring back to O. The fixed anchor and ring position are unchanged, restoring the same extension and orientation. This single force reproduces the original pair’s effect. Restore the actual point rather than relying on a visual approximation or assuming the two numerical readings should simply be added.

cues.title: 比较矢量记录
cues.caption: 两个力作邻边，等效单力对应对角线。
cues.captionEn: The pair forms adjacent sides; the single force matches the diagonal.
cues.zh: 把器材暂时退到背景，看留在纸上的矢量记录。两个力从同一个O点出发，用相同标度画出大小和方向，再补成平行四边形。它的对角线与单力的大小和方向吻合。对角线是等效合力，不是又多加了第三个实际拉力；如果把三个箭头都当作同时存在的拉力，就改变了原实验。
cues.en: Read the vector record separately from the apparatus. Draw both forces from O using one scale, then complete the parallelogram. Its diagonal matches the single force in magnitude and direction. This is an equivalent resultant, not an additional third pull. Treating all three arrows as simultaneous physical forces would describe a different experiment.

cues.title: 交换操作研究分解
cues.caption: 同一合力可由不同方向的一对分力实现。
cues.captionEn: Different directed pairs can reproduce the same resultant.
cues.zh: 最后交换操作顺序。先用一个力确定O点，再用两个力把圆环恢复到这里，就是研究力的分解。改变两条方向，各自读数会改变，但橡皮条的同一效果可以保持。只有合力还不够，通常还需要规定分力的方向才能确定一组答案。自由探索中再改变O点高度，你会看到此时连等效单力也必须改变。
cues.en: Reverse the order: establish O with one force, then restore it with two. This investigates resolution. Changing the directions changes the individual readings while preserving the same strip effect. A resultant alone usually needs additional direction constraints to identify a pair. In exploration, changing O itself also changes the required equivalent single force.

question.zh: 换成一个力，怎样确认作用效果没有变？
question.en: How can one force replace two without changing their effect?

lead.zh: 让同一根橡皮条连接的圆环回到同一个O点，再比较力的方向与大小。
lead.en: Return the same elastic strip’s ring to the same point O, then compare the force vectors.

principle.zh: 同一固定端、同一O点保留橡皮条的作用；两个力的矢量和等于替换它们的单力。
principle.en: The fixed anchor and common point preserve the strip’s force. The vector sum of the pair equals the single replacement force.

question.zh: 合力不变，两个分力的读数是不是也必须不变？
question.en: Must both component readings stay fixed when the resultant is unchanged?

explanation.zh: 不必。改变方向，可以得到另一对分力；它们的水平分量仍相消，竖直分量的和仍等于同一个合力。
explanation.en: No. New directions can give a new pair; horizontal components still cancel and vertical components still sum to the same resultant.
